items.name: burning-screen
items.title: Burning Screen
items.description: One click burns the screen away from where you clicked and shows the next page through the hole. Save it for one big moment, like finishing sign-up.

items.name: agent-draw
items.title: Agent Draw
items.description: Named cursors draw your page's skeleton while its data loads, then the real content fades in. Use it on slow screens, like a dashboard or profile.

items.name: brain-txt
items.title: brain.txt
items.description: A web of dots around a brain, each dot a thought to hover, open and drag. Use it on an about or portfolio page with 8 to 20 short thoughts.

items.name: scratch-me
items.title: Scratch me
items.description: A scratch-off foil hides a promo code that copies itself once revealed. Use it on a pricing, upgrade or thank-you page for one special offer.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password Strength
items.description: A password field that rates what you type as No, AI, AI agent or Human. Use it on sign-up and reset forms in place of a plain strength bar.

items.name: framed-upload
items.title: Framed Upload
items.description: Drop in a picture and it hangs in a frame with a soft shadow, like a print on a wall. Use it on cover or portfolio forms, one picture per frame.

items.name: hex-login
items.title: Hex Login
items.description: A calm login page with your logo inside turning hexagon rings. Use it as your main sign-in page, with your own logo and real sign-in behind it.

items.name: burning-toast
items.title: Burning toast
items.description: Toasts that stack at the bottom of the screen and burn away when they close. Use it in apps and dashboards after a save or send, one short line each.

items.name: text-mirroring
items.title: Text mirroring
items.description: Bold header text that echoes into an infinite glass mirror on hover. Use it on one hero or section title of two to four short words.

items.name: black-hole-refresh
items.title: Black Hole Refresh
items.description: A black hole pulls your page into long thin threads, swallows them and blasts the page back fresh. Use it on refresh for a playful site or portfolio.

items.name: venom-button
items.title: Venom button
items.description: A glossy ink button whose tentacles grab your pointer and pull on it until they snap. Use it for one main action, like the call to action in a hero.

items.name: peter-tingle-button
items.title: Peter Tingle button
items.description: A button that feels your pointer coming and tingles, with wavy lines pulsing toward it. Use it for one main action, like a hero call to action.

items.name: ascii-tide-button
items.title: ASCII Tide button
items.description: A dark button that shows drifting ASCII characters behind its label and sends a calm violet tide on tap. Use it for one main action, like a hero.

items.name: glass-shatter-button
items.title: Glass Shatter button
items.description: A dark button in a ring of glass that glows as your pointer comes near and shatters into shards on click, then seals. Use it for one main action.

items.name: tug-of-work-loader
items.title: Tug of Work loader
items.description: A progress bar where a tiny person drags a heavy stone to 100%, straining when it waits. Use it for uploads, exports and builds that take a while.

items.name: pixel-button
items.title: Pixel button
items.description: A button with twinkling pixels behind its label, on hover or always on, a light circling its edge and a click wave. Use it for one main action.

items.name: peephole-button
items.title: Peephole button
items.description: A glass button with a picture window that opens on hover into the whole image or your brand color. Use it on Contact or Gallery with a real photo.

items.name: task-progress
items.title: Task progress
items.description: A task list that shows what is done, running or next, and strikes tasks through as they finish. Use it on AI agent or setup screens with 5 to 9 steps.

items.name: coffee-faq
items.title: Coffee FAQ
items.description: Questions that open one at a time, with a chat box at the end that types a reply to anything. Use it near the bottom of a landing or pricing page.

items.name: infinite-curl-gallery
items.title: Infinite Curl Gallery
items.description: Pictures drift on an endless canvas you can throw any way, curling and fading at its edges. Use it on a portfolio or moodboard with 8 to 30 pictures.

items.name: orrery-gallery
items.title: Orrery Gallery
items.description: Round pictures orbit your name, fall into a stack and open into a curved strip you drag. Use it on a portfolio or launch page with 6 to 12 links.

items.name: window-stats
items.title: Window Stats
items.description: Your numbers on photo cards that slide over a still statement, which softens behind them. Use it on an about or landing page with 3 to 7 numbers.

items.name: spindle-gallery
items.title: Spindle Gallery
items.description: Round pictures orbit and stack, then open into a 3D ring of cards with space between them. Use it on a launch or portfolio page with 8 to 12 posters.

items.name: capsule-testimonials
items.title: Capsule Testimonials
items.description: Reviews sit as slim capsules with a face and a name, then open into a full card on click. Use it on a landing or pricing page with 4 to 7 reviews.

items.name: reel-stats
items.title: Reel Stats
items.description: Point at a heading and its picture rolls into the frame as a soft tab glides to it. Use it on a services or landing page with 3 to 6 short points.

items.name: loupe-grid
items.title: Loupe Grid
items.description: A faint grid background whose marks swell, brighten and glow under your pointer. Use it behind a hero or sign-up section with one short headline.

items.name: isometric-wall
items.title: Isometric Wall
items.description: Faded picture cards slide slowly along diagonal columns on a tilted floor, and the one you hover lifts gently. Use it behind a hero with one short headline.

items.name: deck-features
items.title: Deck Features
items.description: Feature cards pile up like a deck as you scroll, and the last one slides through them all. Use it on a landing page to show 3 to 6 features.

items.name: sleeve-card
items.title: Sleeve Card
items.description: A project card lifts and turns in 3D on hover as a View Project tab slides out from behind. Use it on a portfolio page, one card for each project.

items.name: comet-button
items.title: Comet button
items.description: A dark pill whose glow races round its border while it loads, then glides back to rest. Use it on a save or sign up button that waits on a server.

items.name: kitcut-button
items.title: Kitcut button
items.description: A button that cracks down the middle and splits open while it loads, then snaps back with a WooHoo. Use it on your main action, like Publish or Pay.

items.name: tumble-gallery
items.title: Tumble Gallery
items.description: A split flap board for pictures that flips in 3D and lands flat on the next one. Use it on a hero or portfolio page with 4 or more wide pictures.

items.name: spotlight-ticker
items.title: Spotlight Ticker
items.description: A gliding row of pictures stops as the one you point at grows, and a click opens its story. Use it on a home or work page with 5 to 10 projects.

items.name: rolling-clock
items.title: Rolling clock
items.description: A live clock whose digits roll on a curve, the new number rising from below as the old one swings away. Use it in a hero, footer or dashboard header.

items.name: peek-list
items.title: Peek List
items.description: Point at a row and its picture follows your pointer; a click opens the row like a pop up. Use it for 3 to 8 products, services or features.

items.name: settle-counter
items.title: Settle counter
items.description: A number where each changed digit arrives big and faint, then settles in as the old one fades. Use it large, on a live count in a hero or dashboard.

items.name: click-pop
items.title: Click Pop
items.description: A small pop at the pointer on every click: burst, ring, particles, crosshair or wavy. Use it once in your layout, in a calm color, for the whole site.

items.name: tile-flip-image
items.title: Tile flip image
items.description: A picture that turns over in tiny tiles, in random order, onto the next one in 1.2 seconds. Use it on a hero or product shot that changes.

items.name: cube-flip-image
items.title: Cube flip image
items.description: Click a picture and tiny cubes roll over from that spot, a wave that shows the next one. Use it on a gallery or hero with 3 to 10 photos.

items.name: puzzle-refresh
items.title: Puzzle Refresh
items.description: Your page cracks into jigsaw pieces that tumble into a heap, then fly back up and click into place. Use it on refresh for a playful site or portfolio.

items.name: peek-index
items.title: Peek Index
items.description: Numbered rows whose picture or video follows your pointer; a click opens a story with points and a link. Made for 3 to 8 services or products.

items.name: liquid-orbit-loader
items.title: Liquid Orbit loader
items.description: A drop of liquid floats and wobbles in a liquid ring, then pours away and rises back. Use it on a first load or a dashboard waiting on data.

items.name: chain-testimonials
items.title: Chain Testimonials
items.description: Picture cards joined like a chain, and the middle one opens into a review. The chain shifts on its own. Use it on a landing page with 5 to 9 reviews.
